freeze_order: Before V2 eligibility computation; zero perturbations and zero new simulations. Original V1 screen is retained unchanged.
correction: V1 used the signed time-averaged plume wind as the sole outflow-side selector. In H02-WD its magnitude is near zero, and the selected ymax edge has negligible mass even while xmin/ymin retain substantial mass. This is a demonstrated screening-design defect, not a failed intervention or threshold relaxation.
allowed_sources: Only the frozen R0C source0/source1 in each House, z=0.30 m.
allowed_winds: Only the existing WA/WB or WC/WD contexts; no new wind context.
realizations: All four existing realizations per House/wind/gas/source cell.
boundary_mask: Union of the outer three rows/columns on ALL FOUR horizontal domain sides, counting corners once. This replaces the unstable net-wind side selector and includes diffusive edge support when the mean wind cancels.
acceptance: Each of the four realizations must satisfy the unchanged mean/q95 mass thresholds. The centroid at all 31 aligned times and the source must be at least three bins from EVERY horizontal side. Original geometry/source/state hashes must pass.
selection: Prefer first eligible case per House in gas/wind/source lexical order; if only one House qualifies, first two distinct source cases there. At most two base cases. Gas is fixed per paired intervention. Source-inference candidate sets use both previously frozen source positions.
no_eligible_case: W0C_STAGE0_NO_CLEAN_BASE_HOLD. No perturbation or GADEN runs, no threshold relaxation, source relocation, new seed, or new House. This is prerequisite failure, not evidence for W0C_GLOBAL_ERROR_SUFFICIENT_STOP.
claim_limit: Edge-supported column mass is a proxy for truncation risk, not an estimate of physical mass lost through outflow. The native 0.2 m field caches and 32x32 footprints limit resolution.
